title: REST JSON not-found, the body's lowercase code member
why: The REST JSON spelling: the body names the code in a lowercase `code` member, which is the third of the parsed-body spellings the Errors table lists. The x-amzn-errortype header a REST JSON service usually sends alongside it is deliberately not on this wire: botocore's RestJSONParser._inject_error_code prefers the header and falls back to the body member, so a wire carrying both would have every suite matching through the header while the fixture claimed the body. Stripped to the body alone, the fixture pins what it says it pins.

expect.name: a near miss the observed code ends with
